push.title: W 4-2 vs IronClad City | You: 9.6 (3rd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Your 3rd best match performance of the season, PhogsToffees. A 9.6 against IronClad City. That's the good stuff, bottled and labeled.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at IronClad City's goal. Shooting is believing, and you believed.
+ 3 key passes. You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed.
+ Man of the Match, your 24th for us. That's a captain's performance, armband or not.
+ This was the win that got us promoted out of Division 3. Everybody gets a slice of that pie.
+ That link with BellyTb1 was smoother than a Cadillac on new pavement.

THE BAD
- Misplaced passes 9, up from your usual 5. Coach's tip: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
- Tackle success 0%, down from your usual 29%. We can fix that.
- Shots on target: 80%. Don't settle; 90%+ is there for the taking.

Garden drill: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.

Listen here, PhogsToffees: Don't count the days; make the days count. Then count the goals.

You're the real deal. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-2 vs IronClad City | You: 9.3
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 9.3 against IronClad City. You were a problem for them all night, the good kind.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes. You set the table and let everybody else eat.
+ A goal against IronClad City. One swing, one goal, zero doubt.
+ This was the win that got us promoted out of Division 3. Enjoy it. Then go get the next one.
+ That connection with PhogsToffees is gold. Don't let it rust.
+ 6th straight match at 7.5 match rating. Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Tell you what: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot. Mind over matter.
- You and buddskees, same shot selection homework. Partners: cut it back to each other.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 1 (best was buddskees's 6). Habit to build: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
- Pass accuracy: 80%. Solid ground. The best forwards push it to 88%+.

Five-minute drill: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

BellyTb1, take this with you: The best ability is availability, and the second best is kindness.

Nothing but pride over here. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-2 vs IronClad City | You: 7.9
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.9 against IronClad City. Not your day, partner, but days are short and seasons are long.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at IronClad City's goal. You were hungry in front of goal, and I love a hungry striker.
+ This was the win that got us promoted out of Division 3. That one belongs to all of us, and you were in it.
+ Tackles won 4, up from your usual 1. Small wins add up to big ones.
+ 5th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's what showing up looks like.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (19 vs their best 16). You can build a whole match on that.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Start here: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound. Easy money.
- Team project for you and BellyTb1: shot selection. The plan: cut it back to each other.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.9 (best was PhogsToffees's 9.6). That's the bit that kept us from winning.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was BellyTb1's 2). That needs to look different next time out.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 24 (best was PhogsToffees's 34). Little adjustment: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.

Training note: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

buddskees, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: The ball will find the player who wants it. Want it.

On to the next one. - Coach Lasso
